buildings.identified_as: Abbotts Square Condominiums, 200-210 Lombard St / 530 S 2nd St (aka 201 South St). L-shaped 8-level mixed-use block built 1982-85 (developer Jack W. Blumenfeld) on the former Abbotts Dairies site; 171 condos (floors 5-8), 47 'Headhouse Flats' apartments on floor 4 (former parking deck), commercial mezzanine on 3, double-height retail at grade (26,150 sf, 450 ft of South St frontage, 21 ft ceilings), public garage in the basement. OPA: 'RES CONDO 5+ STY MAS+OTH', year 1985.
buildings.confidence: high (address match from Philadelphia OPA parcel at the exact coordinate, LiDAR footprint 5,893 m2 matches OSM area; massing from 2025 city 3-inch ortho + 2023 drone photos)
buildings.massing: Footprint is a true L hugging the WEST curb of 2nd St and the NORTH curb of South St (South St runs WNW, so the south wing is skewed ~9 deg off E-W). Local coords (x east, z south, m): 2nd St wing east face runs from (-80,366) at Lombard to (-97,464) at South St, ~22 m deep at the Lombard end widening to ~29 m (west face ~(-103,381) to (-121,430)). South St wing south face runs from (-97,464) to (-236,440) at 3rd St, ~29 m deep (north face ~(-131,428) to (-211,415)), with a short ~20 m return up 3rd St to (-233,420). LiDAR (city 2017): max 93.9 ft = 28.6 m, footprint-average 70 ft = 21.3 m (OSM 30.2 m is slightly high). HEIGHT BY PART: (1) 2nd St wing, full length Lombard-to-South: 8 levels, parapet ~28.5 m; ground floor is double-height retail (~6.5 m: TD Bank at the Lombard corner, vacant Wawa/storefronts, the residential lobby with black 'Abbotts Square' awnings mid-block), then 7 floors at ~3.15 m. The top (8th) floor is partly bi-level penthouses with recessed roof terraces cut into it (three or four square terrace voids visible from above, tan pavers) and a glazed greenhouse-style penthouse near the 2nd/South corner; slightly taller elevator/mechanical bulkheads (~31 m) near both ends. (2) South St wing: steps DOWN westward. Eastern third (x -97 to ~-150): same 7-8 levels ~26-28.5 m. Middle (x ~-150 to -200): 6 levels ~23 m (retail + 5 residential floors, recessed balconies). Western end at 3rd St (x -200 to -236): 5 levels ~19-20 m plus a set-back white-clad penthouse floor with terraces (~22 m), and a 1-storey (~5 m) retail loading dock box at the 3rd St end. (3) Inside the L, along the north side of the South St wing at z ~415-430, a lower 3-4 storey (~12-13 m) 'garden-level townhouse' bar with planted terraces stepping down to the interior court (dark membrane roof). (4) The rest of the block interior (Philip St and the south side of Lombard, x -125 to -225, z 365-415) is filled with separate 2002-2006 three/four-storey rowhouses with grey mansard roofs and surface parking; these are NOT part of the Abbotts footprint. Basement public garage under the whole L with ramp from South St end / loading on 3rd St. All roofs flat, light-grey membrane with HVAC units; rooftop terraces with tan pavers and planters.
buildings.facade_notes: Material: warm orange-brown modular brick (sunlit ~#B07A55, shaded ~#7E5238) with continuous cream precast/limestone string courses at the top of the retail floor and at each parapet, cream precast copings. Windows: large dark-bronze/black aluminum sliders (~1.5 m w x 1.5 m h, sill ~0.8 m), one window plus one recessed balcony per ~3.6 m structural bay; residential floor-to-floor ~3.15 m; recessed balconies (~2.4 m wide) with white/cream painted metal railings, deeper two-storey notches and bay windows near corners; a few through-wall AC grilles (dark brown) under windows. Ground floor: continuous black-framed storefront glazing on both 2nd St and South St, cream precast bulkhead, red/black fabric awnings, black canvas entrance canopies ('Abbotts Square') on 2nd St; the 2nd/South corner retail (former bank) is blank brick above chamfered storefront. West (3rd St) end: pale yellow-buff painted ground floor. Roof: flat grey membrane #B8B5AD, terraces #C9A98F, white penthouse walls #E4E2DC.
buildings.roof: Flat membrane (light grey #B8B5AD) with rooftop terraces, mechanical bulkheads and a glazed penthouse conservatory near 2nd & South; stepped-back white penthouse at the 3rd St end; parapets capped cream precast.

buildings.identified_as: 410 at Society Hill, 410 S Front St - Toll Brothers City Living gated condo building (55 units, 108-110 space underground garage), architect Toll Architecture, built 2013-2015 on the former NewMarket (1975-2002) site; OSM way 806482730 'building=apartments'. OPA: 'RES CONDO 4 STY MAS+OTH', year 2015.
buildings.confidence: high (OPA records at the coordinate all read 410 S FRONT ST; LiDAR footprint 2,651 m2 vs OSM 2,480 m2)
buildings.massing: L-shaped 4-storey bar on a concrete garage podium, wrapping the NE of a private courtyard. Local coords: main bar along the WEST curb of Front St from (52,307) at the north to (68,363) at the south, ~28 m deep (west face x ~44-48), i.e. 57 m long; a second arm runs WEST from it along the north edge of the site, x -1 to 48, z 310-343 (~48 m long, ~30 m deep), ending ~40 m short of 2nd St where a gated pocket park/walkway (circular planter, brick paths) connects to 2nd St just south of 401 S 2nd. The courtyard (lawn, reflecting pool, paved terrace) occupies the SW quadrant (x 0-44, z 343-362) and is bounded on the south by the rear yards of the 1800s Lombard St rowhouses (107-123 Lombard). Heights: stated 68 ft (20.7 m) total; LiDAR max 72 ft = 22.0 m (roof-deck bulkheads/pergola at the Front St end), average 53 ft = 16.2 m. Use: podium/first-floor slab ~1.2 m above sidewalk, 4 residential floors at ~3.6 m (10-ft ceilings) -> main parapet ~16.5-17 m; elevator/stair bulkheads and a wood-decked roof lounge with planted screens at the NE (Front St) corner rising to ~21-22 m. Balconies project ~1.5 m on the courtyard faces; Juliet balconies on the street faces. Roof: flat, brown ballast/gravel with large rectangular green-roof trays and rooftop HVAC rows; wood roof deck over the Front St bar.
buildings.facade_notes: Material: medium red face brick (#9C4B3F) in running bond with full-height vertical bays of buff/cream brick (#D8C9AB) framing the window stacks, and a limestone/cream precast wainscot (#D2CBB9) at the ground floor; dark charcoal (#2F2F2F) aluminum windows. Rhythm: window stacks every ~4.0 m; each bay has a wide window (~2.4 m x 2.1 m, nearly floor-to-ceiling) or sliding door; floor-to-floor ~3.6 m. Balconies: recessed and projecting balconies with dark painted steel frames and wire-mesh/cable infill rails (~1.1 m high); Juliet rails on the Front St face. Ground floor: glazed lobby/concierge entrance on Front St, cream stone base, gated courtyard entry from the 2nd St pocket park; garage entrance on Front St. Clean flat-topped parapet with thin metal coping.
buildings.roof: Flat; brown gravel ballast (#8C7B5F) with green-roof sections (#6E7A45) and HVAC; wood roof-deck lounge with wood/ivy privacy screens at the NE corner on Front St; small bulkheads.

buildings.identified_as: 'New Market Complex', 415-419 S 2nd St (Cavanaugh's Headhouse pub at 421 S 2nd in the corner bay; 8,400 sf former CVS): the surviving 1970s NewMarket-era 3-storey brick commercial block at the NE corner of 2nd & Lombard, 33,500 sf on a 17,808 sf (0.41 ac) lot, CMX-2, owner Sudi LP; OPA lists it as 'STR/OFF 3 STY MASONRY' with placeholder year 1900.
buildings.confidence: high on identity (OPA parcel 419 S 2ND ST is 5 m from the coordinate, LiDAR footprint 1,332 m2 = OSM 1,330 m2); medium on facade detail (one street photo + ortho)
buildings.massing: Occupies the east side of 2nd St from the Toll pocket-park walkway south to Lombard: local coords x -41 to -5, z 317 to 368; 2nd St (west) face x ~-33 to -41 (set slightly back from the rowhouse line at the north), Lombard (south) face z 364-368 from x -41 to -15, east edge x ~-5/-8 against the 410 courtyard/walkway; a narrower northern leg x -18 to -5 at z 320-325. Two visually distinct parts: (1) the CORNER block at 2nd & Lombard (z ~340-368, ~24 m along 2nd, ~26 m along Lombard): 3 storeys, flat white roof, parapet ~11-12 m (LiDAR avg 37 ft = 11.3 m); ground-floor pub with outdoor seating; (2) the NORTH part (z 317-340, ~23 m along 2nd St): 3 storeys of brick with three grey-shingled gable roofs facing 2nd St (ridges ~15.5 m; LiDAR max 51 ft = 15.6 m; OSM 15.5 m is the ridge height, use ~11.5 m for the corner block). Rear (east) portions are lower 2-storey flat-roofed infill (~8 m). Everything sits on ground ~0.7 m lower than Abbotts (base elev 26.4 ft vs 28.8 ft).
buildings.facade_notes: Material: dark brown-red 1970s brick (#7F4B3B) with flush precast sills; upper floors have tall rectangular punched openings (~1.8 m w x 2.4 m h, pitch ~3.0 m) with dark bronze frames, some paired; floor-to-floor ~3.3 m. Ground floor of the corner block: dark-stained wood storefront (#4A3526) with large divided windows, brown fabric awnings and a projecting 'Cavanaugh's Headhouse' sign; some blind brick panels where CVS was. Gable section: grey asphalt-shingle gables (#6B6B6B) over brick walls, smaller 6/6-style windows to match the neighbours. Corner flat roof white membrane (#D9D9D4) with HVAC.
buildings.roof: Corner block flat (white membrane); north part three steep gables (grey shingle) facing 2nd St; rear flat.

buildings.identified_as: New Market Garage, 215 Lombard St / 420-434 S 2nd St - 4-level (3 decks + open roof deck) public parking structure built 1976 (owner WM Garage Associates, operator Park America), 124,220 sf on a 36,478 sf lot, OPA 'GAR W/COMM AREA MASONRY'; the ground-floor commercial wrap on 2nd St holds Pizzeria Stella (420 S 2nd, STARR) at the NW corner of 2nd & Lombard. Built as the substitute for unbuilt houses in the Van Arkel & Moss Blackwell Place redevelopment.
buildings.confidence: high (OPA parcel 15 m from coordinate; LiDAR footprint 3,116 m2 = OSM 3,100 m2; ortho shows open rooftop parking)
buildings.massing: Rectangle filling the block interior between 2nd St and the Blackwell Place townhouse court: local coords x -165 to -71, z 301 to 352 (east face on the 2nd St west curb from z ~318 to 351; south face ~8 m north of the Lombard curb from x -90 to -165 - the strip between it and Lombard at 231-237 Lombard is a surface lot; north face z ~301-315 against the Blackwell Place gardens; west face x -159/-165 on S Philip St alignment). Heights: LiDAR average 29 ft = 8.8 m (the open top parking deck), max 44 ft = 13.4 m (stair/elevator tower). Model as: 3 enclosed parking levels, top slab at ~8.8 m with a ~1.1 m parapet (~10 m), an open rooftop deck striped for cars (grey concrete, two ramps in the middle), a brick stair/elevator tower ~13.5 m near the 2nd St side (x ~-90, z ~345) and small light poles. Along the entire 2nd St face a 2-storey brick commercial liner (~8 m high, ~9 m deep) with storefronts and awnings, chamfered at the 2nd/Lombard corner (Pizzeria Stella, with its 'STELLA' blade sign); vehicle entry/exit ramps from Lombard St (215 Lombard, ~x -120) and a pedestrian exit on 2nd St. OSM 14.7 m / building:levels=4 overstate the deck height.
buildings.facade_notes: Liner on 2nd St: dark red-brown brick (#6F3B30) 2 storeys, large steel-framed storefront windows at grade with dark brown/black fabric awnings, square second-floor windows at ~3 m pitch, flat brick parapet. Garage body: exposed grey concrete spandrels (#B4B2AA) with open horizontal slots between decks (~1.2 m high) and brick end walls; rooftop deck light-grey concrete with white striping; stair tower brick with a dark metal door.
buildings.roof: Open rooftop parking deck (grey concrete) with parapet, two internal ramps and a small stair tower; liner buildings flat with small HVAC units.

buildings.identified_as: West frame of Head House Square: 400-416 S 2nd St (OSM way '400-16', OPA 'RES CONDO 3.5 STY MASONRY' over 'COM CONDO 1 STY') - a row of seven c.1790-1810 Federal red-brick townhouses from the SW corner of 2nd & Pine (400-402, the former Artful Dodger, now Society Hill Society, c.1790s 'Head House Tavern' site) south to 416 (former Xochitl at 408, shops, law offices), then the 1976 garage liner with Pizzeria Stella at the Lombard corner (see D). Behind them: 1-8 Blackwell Place (1982, 3-storey brick condos around a lawn court) and 208-226 Pine St (1969, 3-storey condos).
buildings.confidence: high (Commons photo 'HeadHouseSquare.JPG' shows the whole row; LiDAR per-house heights)
buildings.massing: Seven contiguous houses on the west curb of 2nd St (x ~-64 east face) between z 264 (Pine) and z 310, each 5-6.5 m wide and 17-23 m deep, 3 full storeys plus dormered attic: cornice ~11.5-12.5 m, ridge 13.7-15.3 m (LiDAR 45-50 ft), floor-to-floor ~3.3 m, pitched roofs (~35-40 deg) with the ridge parallel to 2nd St, 2 dormers per house, brick party-wall chimneys at the ridge, some 1-2 storey rear ells. The corner house at Pine (400-402) is 3.5 storeys with its long side on Pine. South of 416 the street wall drops to the 2-storey (~8 m) garage liner (x ~-71 face) which runs to Lombard. Opposite, the east side 400 block (401 S 2nd John Ross House at the Pine corner, 3.5 storeys, LiDAR 51-60 ft ~ 15.5-18 m; 403-413 S 2nd a set of 2-3 storey brick pavilions with brown pyramidal shingle roofs) is similar in scale. Ground here is ~1 m lower than at South St (base elev ~26 ft).
buildings.facade_notes: Material: unpainted red brick, Flemish bond with some darker glazed headers (#9E4E3C, shaded #7E3E30); white-painted wood trim (#EFEBE0): box cornices with dentils, window frames, dormer cheeks; a few houses have dark green or red painted shutters/doors (#2F4A3A, #8A2B22). Windows: 6/6 double-hung sash ~0.9 m w x 1.7 m h, 3 bays per house at ~1.9 m pitch, stone sills, flat brick arches; attic dormers with 6/6 sash under pitched hoods. Ground floor: shopfronts - white-painted projecting multi-pane bow/bay windows (~2.4 m wide), recessed doors with fanlights, painted wood bulkheads, small projecting signs; a few houses keep plain door+window fronts with marble steps. Roof: grey slate/asphalt (#5B5B5B), snow-white in winter photos; standing-seam metal on some dormers. Garage liner at 420: dark red-brown brick (#6F3B30), 2 storeys, awnings.
buildings.roof: Pitched (gable, ridge parallel to street, ~35-40 deg) grey slate/asphalt with dormers and brick chimneys; garage liner flat.

NOTES FOR MODELLING: (1) Abbotts' OSM single outline should be split: 2nd St wing 28.5 m; South St wing 27 m (east third) -> 23 m (middle) -> 19.5 m + 22 m penthouse (west end) -> 5 m loading box at 3rd St; interior garden bar 12.5 m. (2) 410 main roof ~16.5-17 m with a 21-22 m roof-deck/bulkhead zone over the Front St bar; OSM 15 m is low. (3) 419 S 2nd: corner block 11.5 m flat, north part gables to 15.5 m. (4) Garage deck 8.8-10 m, stair tower 13.5 m, 2nd St liner 8 m. (5) Abbotts brick is noticeably more orange than the 18th-century red brick of the rowhouses; 410 is a brighter cherry red with buff bays; Cavanaugh's/NewMarket remnant and the garage liner are the darkest brown-red. (6) East side 403-413 S 2nd (between John Ross House and the 410 pocket park) are 2-3 storey brick NewMarket-era pavilions with brown pyramidal shingle roofs (~9-11 m), not rowhouses. (7) 2021 Headhouse Plaza: the former median parking at Lombard/South ends of 2nd St now has two small steel 'butterfly' canopies and a triangular paved plaza; the 2nd St median south of Lombard in front of Abbotts is angled parking with a triangular pavilion at the South St end.
